name: volleyball
frame_prompt: Create a photorealistic 16:9 first frame in a simple indoor volleyball court. Show one adult athlete at full-body scale from a locked side-rear camera. The athlete stands beneath one volleyball with both hands raised in a ready setting pose. Keep the hands, ball, face, torso, and floor visible. No net is required. No other balls, players, text, logos, or watermark.
video_prompt: Use the picture I gave as first frame strictly to start the video. Generate an 8-second photorealistic video with a completely static camera and no cuts, zooms, or slow motion. The athlete performs five rapid controlled overhead volleyball sets, contacting the ball briefly with both hands each time and allowing a clear short flight between contacts. Add one soft but distinct hand-ball impact sound at each set, precisely synchronized, with no sound during flight. Preserve a continuous ballistic trajectory between contacts. The ball must not float, teleport, duplicate, deform, or change direction without hand contact.
